question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
-- Full comprehensive seller performance report
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orv.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 3600) as avg_packing_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL 
      AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pt.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as cat_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rn
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pt.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_quantity,
    ROUND(sm.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
    ROUND(sm.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sr.avg_review_score, 2) as avg_review_score,
    ROUND(sp.avg_packing_hours, 2) as avg_packing_hours,
    stc.product_category_name_english as top_category
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sm.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON sm.seller_id = sp.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_top_category stc ON sm.seller_id = stc.seller_id AND stc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC

The order_reviews table stores customer feedback for specific orders. The product_category_name_translation table provides English names for product categories found in the products table. The geolocation table contains geographic coordinates for zip code prefixes. The customers table holds customer identifiers and location data.
